items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: Back to this band with Eddie Pearson though playing bass

ctx.x: Cleveland and Galveston. Oh yeah. Dutch.
Back to this band with Eddie Pearson though playing bass and Frankie and the Frank Crump you say is playing alto sax, huh? Yeah. Was that a spot band or what is that?
No, a regular lineup, regular bands. See we got uniforms. We started on at the Lucky Pair. Where's that? The Lucky Pair was at Dolphin and Congress. The Lucky Pair. Mm-hmm. The Lucky Pair.
